places.quote: he beguiled the distance between Clerkenwell and the mansion of the Golden Dustman
places.note: Wegg's route from his shop; the shop itself is not named here.

places.as_written: the mansion of the Golden Dustman
places.quote: without first hovering over Mr Boffin’s house in the superior character of its Evil Genius
places.note: House not named in this passage; identified by Boffin's residence and the dust-heap setting. Harmony Jail is the novel's name for it, not stated here.
